status: experimental COM core and typed mission payload codecs implemented; GUI/dispatcher integration pending
crc: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over header+payload; integrity only, not authentication
payload_policy: Typed mission telemetry and commands are defined in mission_payloads.json and mission_payloads.hpp. NodeCom remains payload-agnostic: applications must select the correct schema against the validated message kind and node. Command decoding is not authorization or execution. Result payload remains one ResultCode byte.
session_policy: Nonzero boot/session identities and authenticated peer sessions supplied explicitly. No discovery or persistence implementation; recreate service with new configuration after boot/session change. Never reuse a session with a reset message counter.
capacity_policy: Skeleton bounds, not tuned flight settings: RX budget8/tick, reply queue8, received telemetry queue8, command queue4, result event queue16, receipts8; never evict unfinished receipts.
retry_policy: One outstanding command per flight peer; max_attempts counts queued radio submissions, not immediate API rejections. Retries keep identity. TTL produces UNKNOWN, never proof of non-execution.
usb_policy: Existing C/P LF codec retained unchanged; future readable typed USB records and CR-terminated competition export need a separate size and schema review.
configuration_policy: No team, MAC, channel, boot sessions, flight retry timings, pins or private keys selected.
